Messages.Body:
Does a Path (of any sort) lower the cost for cards you play when your
oponent plays Terror Frenzy and increase the cost of combat cards? Similar
does Dragos still play 0 blood and Meshenka still pay one less?

Daniel Eriksson
Sweden

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Daniel Eriksson wrote:
>
> Does a Path (of any sort) lower the cost for cards you play when your
> oponent plays Terror Frenzy and increase the cost of combat cards? Similar
> does Dragos still play 0 blood and Meshenka still pay one less?

Terror Frenzy doesn't affect the cost of the card at all.

Terror Frenzy (at superior) causes the vampire to burn a blood whenever
he plays a combat card.

Effects that change/ignore the cost of cards have no bearing on this
"burn blood" effect.
